rationale: Redesigning a cramped B2B estimating toolbar requires functional clarity over decorative flair. We eliminate the 'rainbow button' noise by standardizing most actions to monochrome/ghost styles and reserving high-contrast color exclusively for status indicators and primary actions (Save). The layout shifts from a jammed 40px row to a structured 56px row with logical vertical zones and an overflow account menu, achieving breathing room without sacrificing density.

layout_zones.structure: Flex container with 5 distinct zones separated by subtle vertical dividers (`border-r border-[var(--spot-line)]`).

Zone_1_Brand.styling: flex items-center gap-3 pr-4 border-r border-[var(--spot-line)]

Zone_2_Context.styling: flex-1 min-w-0 flex flex-col justify-center px-4 border-r border-[var(--spot-line)]
Zone_2_Context.behavior: Stacked 2-line layout. Line 1: `[Initials Pill]` + `[Est # in Mono]` + `[Customer Name truncate max-w-[200px]]`. Line 2: `↳ [Project Name truncate max-w-[300px]]`. Wrap truncated strings in tooltips.

Zone_3_Actions.styling: flex items-center gap-1 px-4 border-r border-[var(--spot-line)]
Zone_3_Actions.hierarchy: Neutralized. All buttons are 'ghost' variants with lucide-react icons. Stripped of their original pink/purple/blue backgrounds to reduce noise. Hover states apply `bg-[var(--spot-bg2)]`.

Zone_4_Status_Save.styling: flex items-center gap-3 px-4 border-r border-[var(--spot-line)]
Zone_4_Status_Save.hierarchy: Multi-Part is ghost (amber icon if active). Status Dropdown is an outline button with a colored DOT indicator (not full bg). Save is the only solid colored button (Green) to guide primary intent.

Zone_5_User.behavior: A simple 'User' avatar or '⋯' trigger button. Clicking opens a Shadcn DropdownMenu containing: User Email (disabled label), Theme Toggle, Admin Console (if applicable), and Logout.

buttons.primary: bg-[var(--spot-green)] text-white hover:bg-[var(--spot-green-soft)] transition-colors rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium shadow-sm
buttons.ghost: bg-transparent text-[var(--spot-text)] hover:bg-[var(--spot-bg2)] transition-colors rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium inline-flex items-center gap-2
buttons.outline: border border-[var(--spot-border)] text-[var(--spot-text)] hover:bg-[var(--spot-bg2)] transition-colors rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium shadow-sm inline-flex items-center gap-2

status_dropdown.design: Instead of full colored backgrounds (which screamed for attention unnecessarily), use a neutral outline button with a 8px colored circle (`w-2 h-2 rounded-full`) next to the text. This maps perfectly to the `status_colors` schema.

tooltips.design: Standard inverted tooltips wrapping the Customer Name and Project Name elements to reveal full text upon hover since they are truncated to prevent layout collapsing.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Do NOT modify any part of the application other than the top toolbar (Toolbar.jsx / Header.jsx).
2. COMPLETELY REMOVE the 'File checkbox' and 'Undo button' from the UI per the user's explicit request.

3. Apply the 56px (`h-14`) Mega-Row layout structured into the 5 explicit flex zones defined above. Ensure the header uses `bg-[var(--spot-bg)]` and a bottom border of `border-b border-[var(--spot-border)]`.

4. Implement string truncation using Tailwind's `truncate` class on Customer Name and Project Name strings. Constrain their max-widths (e.g., `max-w-[200px]` and `max-w-[300px]`) on standard screens and wrap them in Radix/Shadcn Tooltips to expose full text.
5. Fold the rarely used items ('Theme toggle', 'User email display', 'Admin button', and 'Sign out') into a clean Dropdown Menu positioned on the far right (Zone 5).
6. Convert the loud actions ('Load', 'Quote Header', 'Preview Quote', and 'Cost Report') into neutral 'ghost' buttons with icons. Ensure text color maps to `--spot-text` to kill the rainbow noise.
7. Update the Quote Status dropdown to utilize the 'colored dot' indicator pattern instead of full-button background colors.
8. Ensure the 'Save' button remains the most prominent primary action mapped to `--spot-green`.
9. Use `data-testid` attributes on all interactive elements in the toolbar (e.g., `data-testid="toolbar-save-btn"`, `data-testid="toolbar-status-dropdown"`, `data-testid="toolbar-user-menu"`).
10. Verify that your styling relies heavily on the `--spot-*` variables so the new header works flawlessly in both existing Light and Dark themes.
